gaps.sentence: He must ___ left already — his coat isn't here.
gaps.explanation: 'must have + participle' = certain about the past.

gaps.sentence: No matter how hard he pulled, he ___ open the drawer.
The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.

gaps.sentence: We're going to ___ our flight if we don't hurry.
gaps.hint: be too late for a plane
gaps.explanation: 'miss a flight/train/bus' = arrive too late for it.
'Wish + would' complains about something you want to stop or change.

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ forward to Monday.
gaps.explanation: 'bring forward' = move to an earlier time (opposite of put off).

gaps.sentence: She should be ashamed of ___ for saying that.
